scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:e2e:all
scripts.test:e2e:next: npm --prefix .. run build && npm run test:e2e:next:run
scripts.test:e2e:all: npm run test:e2e; playwright_status=$?; npm run test:e2e:next:run; next_status=$?; if [ $playwright_status -ne 0 ] || [ $next_status -ne 0 ]; then exit 1; fi
